status: PREPARED — the Product Owner's Speechmatics order (2026-10-28): Speechmatics only, real-time streaming ASR on consenting human recordings, one bounded run after an explicit approval (asr-sm-approval.json). Nothing has been sent.
region: EU (pinned; the global endpoint may route anywhere)

guard.keyFile: ~/.qandeel/speechmatics-api-key.txt (per user, outside the repository; read into memory by the launcher only)
guard.reservation: each session reserves its timeout (the line's audio + the tail silence + the margin) at the arm's hourly price, and settles at its measured wall time, which bounds the audio Speechmatics can bill

terms.holds: real-time audio is never recorded or stored; it is processed in memory and the transcripts are returned and discarded
clause 10.4: no use of customer data for machine learning or model training unless the workspace opts in (the portal model-training setting)
the model-training opt-in (a 33 % discount) is off by default

settings: the workspace model-training setting stays OFF; the Product Owner confirms it in the approval (modelTrainingOff: true) before the run
real-time only: no batch job is created, so nothing is held for the batch retention of 7 days
no translation, no speaker identification, no audio events
privacy.notes: The transcripts of the consenting speakers are kept only in the gitignored run directory and deleted with the recordings at S8B-01 closure.

arms.role: the production candidate: the only Speechmatics configuration with Arabic–English code-switching in one stream, server end-of-utterance detection, max_delay control and a custom dictionary
the comparison the Product Owner named: automatic multilingual, cheaper, but no ar_en pack, no silence end-of-utterance (the client forces it), no max_delay and no custom dictionary

audio.encoding: pcm_s16le, the recording's own sample rate (mono; channels averaged)
audio.format: WAV (PCM 16/24/32-bit or float 32); another format needs ffmpeg, which is not installed

set.name: core
set.speakerNote: S1 and S2: one man and one woman, native Egyptian speakers, each with explicit written consent kept by the Product Owner outside the repository
set.recordings: artifacts/evals/s8b-01/corpus/<S#>/<S#>_<line>_<condition>.wav (gitignored); a spontaneous answer's reference is the speaker's own transcript beside it as .txt

measures: WER / CER, corpus level, per arm × dialect, category, condition and speaker; English words scored in Latin or a listed Arabic spelling
checks: names / key terms, numbers (digits or the spoken words), the intended word of a self-correction, the English words
first partial after speech onset; the last final after speech end; E = EndOfUtterance after speech end; A = the last final after EndOfUtterance; final lag after its audio

acceptance.note: Preregistered for ENHANCED_AR_EN, the production candidate (MELIA_1 is reported against the same lines). From bench-plan.json asr.proposedThresholds (WER, A) and the plan's 0.5 s end-of-utterance trigger. The recommendation follows them; the decision is the Product Owner's. 30 lines × 2 speakers is a first representative set, not a population estimate.
